releases.notes:
A redesigned window. The sidebar is now Overview, Projects, Upload and Stations (⌘1–⌘4). Overview shows what needs attention and a card for protection, collecting clips (or sharing on a station), upload and this Mac. Accounts and Service, with updates, moved to Settings (⌘,). Everything can be done from the keyboard and with VoiceOver: use the Project menu or the toolbar Actions button for a selected project.

### Added
- Overview pane with attention rows, notices and status cards.
- Project menu and toolbar Actions menu for the selected project; VoiceOver announcements for results and new problems.

### Changed
- Accounts and Service (with Check Now and Install Update) are tabs in Settings; "Open Service Settings…" buttons lead there.
- Full Disk Access being off now counts as a problem in the menu bar, the Dock badge and Overview. The Stations badge shows station problems only.
- Clearer text: statuses in normal colour with a coloured symbol, larger text, consistent names (Install Update, Install Service… / Reinstall Service…, Collecting, Transfer code).
- Moved and skipped files, the two-main-stations notice and the notification prompt are notices on Overview.

### Fixed
- "The uploader isn't responding" under heavy load: the app keeps one connection to the uploader and the service instead of one per request.
- Check Refusal in Service no longer reports a false "ACCEPTED".

Google Drive uploads now pick up where they stopped after a failed attempt, instead of starting the file again. Pressing Retry Now while Yandex Disk is finishing a file no longer uploads it a second time.

### Fixed
- Google Drive: after a dropped connection or a restart, the next attempt continues the same upload; the whole file is still checked after upload.
- Yandex Disk: Retry Now during the final answer from the server no longer restarts the file.
- Stopping an upload also stops the file check at once.

### Changed
- Privacy manifests in the app, service and upload agent (no tracking, no data collected).
- Station guide updated for Google Drive, the menu bar item, notifications and the public update feed.

Updates now come from a public feed, so the app no longer carries an access token. Help has a Privacy Policy item, and About has a Support link. If an update is ever signed with a different key, the app now says so clearly and changes nothing.

### Changed
- Update feed moved to a public repository; builds no longer contain an update token. Stations on 0.12.3 and older still update through the previous feed.
- The service installer refuses an update signed with a different update key.
- Copyright and support details in About; note that QTakeSync is not affiliated with IN2CORE.

### Fixed
- System log: account names are no longer shown in clear text; service and upload agent start and stop are kept in the log.
